description: This file defines a final class 'Query' that provides static methods for parsing query strings into arrays and building query strings from arrays. It handles URL encoding variations and supports nested arrays and boolean parameter encoding.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and building URL query strings, with support for encoding options and special cases.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a query string into an associative array, decoding percent-encoded characters, handling multiple values for the same key by storing them in an array.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a query string from an array of parameters, with customizable encoding options and boolean value handling.
